svg.title: Capacity planning
svg.desc: The Black Friday forecast stacks last year's peak of 5,000 requests a second, 40 percent growth, and 20 percent for a TV campaign into 8,400. A load test shows one server handles 300 a second at p99 under 250 ms, so 28 servers is the minimum, 25 percent headroom makes 35, and N+2 makes 37. The cloud quota is only 30, so the team raises it in October.

g.text: quota is 30, a raise takes days
filed in October, not on Thanksgiving

svg.text: 8,400 a second over 300 per server, plus headroom and N+2, is 37 servers.
